newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norske Skog in Czech paper plant deal.
newsitem.headline: Norske Skog in Czech paper plant deal.

text.p: Norwegian forestry company Norske Skogindustrier ASA said on Monday it had signed a letter of intent with Czech paper and pulp company Sepap AS for the acquisition of Sepap's newsprint operation Roto.
Roto has a production capacity of 100,000 tonnes per year of newsprint. The mill is situated at Steti, about 60 km northeast of Prague.
If the cnegotiations are successful Norske Skog will take over the mill in summer 1997, the company said in a statement.

"Norske Skog considers Eastern Europe as a relatively strong growth market for newsprint. It is in line with Norske Skog's development strategy to position itself in growth markets," said Jan Reinaas, the company's president and chief executive officer (CEO).

Tomas Sabatka, Sepap CEO, said the sale of Roto was another step in the ongoing restructuring and streamlining of the group to focus on the core businesses of market pulp, packaging papers, sack paper and converted sacks.
